caption: The drawing features a circular emblem with a thick, segmented border in shades of gold and red. Inside the circle, against a background of mottled brown and tan, there is a white lamb with a faint gray outline and simple facial features. The lamb has a red collar and stands on a surface with stylized gray and red leaves or floral designs near its legs. It holds a red and white striped staff diagonally over its shoulder, with the upper end of the staff bearing a rectangular red flag with three horizontal white stripes. Near its mouth, the lamb holds a red chalice or goblet, and there is a small gray winged figure or detail adjacent to the goblet. The name "Cordena Jackson" is written in small, plain text below the emblem on the cream-colored background.
title: Wooden Plaque - Lamb of God
